int_name: N BROAD ST & W CLEARFIELD ST

result.summary: The intersection features a high-visibility marked crosswalk and sidewalks, but pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median or refuge island. The wide roadway and lack of curb extensions suggest a higher-speed environment with significant exposure for those crossing.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic in a single stage without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Refuge
hazards.description: The absence of a median or island leaves pedestrians exposed in the middle of a wide street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the roadway at the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals and refuge islands. The wide roadway and proximity to a gas station entrance create multiple conflict points for pedestrians crossing the street.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a wide roadway without a refuge island, increasing exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Driveway Conflict Points
hazards.description: The gas station entrance is located immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, creating turning conflicts.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Median Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time safely.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane urban arterial with a high-visibility crosswalk but no median refuge or visible traffic control. The environment prioritizes vehicle throughput, resulting in a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross four lanes of traffic without a median refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No visible signals or stop signs regulate vehicle flow at this marked crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacon (RRFB)
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-activated flashing lights to alert drivers to the presence of people in the crosswalk.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including marked zebra crosswalks, curb ramps, and sidewalks on both sides. However, the environment is dominated by commercial land use with multiple vehicle access points and lacks dedicated pedestrian signals or physical protection like refuge islands.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are visibly worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian walk/don't-walk signals are visible at the signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular signals.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic signal poles at the intersection

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the curb near the intersection may obstruct sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street beyond the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Repainting
interventions.description: Refresh the zebra markings with high-visibility thermoplastic material to improve driver awareness.

interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to drivers.
